## Context
The canonical audit run produced 11,480 passes but exposed two reproducible test-environment assumptions. tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py::test_shipped_surfaces_name_no_retired_bridge_command recursively UTF-8-decodes every file under src/rebar, including ignored editor_assets/node_modules binaries such as the Mach-O esbuild executable. tests/unit/test_attestation_signing.py::test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset clones the current checkout and fails when it is a shallow promisor clone with unavailable historical objects. These are test-hygiene defects, not runtime failures.

## Plan
- Make the shipped-surface test enumerate tracked/package-shipped textual inputs rather than arbitrary working-tree artifacts.
- Make the build-provenance test construct a self-contained minimal Git fixture or explicitly materialize/guard required objects.
- Add negative controls for an ignored binary under the source tree and for a shallow/partial source checkout.
- Keep both tests behavioral: stale shipped command tokens and Git-fallback build provenance must still fail when broken.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The shipped-surface contract passes with an ignored non-UTF-8 binary under src/rebar and still fails when the retired token appears in a shipped text file.
- [x] The provenance fallback test does not depend on the audit checkout having a complete object database.
- [x] The provenance test still proves the wheel embeds git rev-parse --short HEAD when REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT is unset.
- [x] Targeted tests pass in full and shallow/promisor checkout fixtures.
- [x] No broad decode-error swallowing or unconditional skip weakens either oracle.
